units.source_text: 岁历更新了，但谅中世间全无欢庆之举，寂寂地过了新年。

en.t: The year had turned, but in the mourning world there were no celebrations at all, and the New Year passed in silence and loneliness.

units.source_text: 源氏大将倦于世事，只管笼闭室中。

en.t: General Genji had grown weary of worldly affairs and kept himself shut away in his room.

units.source_text: 正月是地方官任免的时节。

en.t: The first month was the season when provincial officials were appointed and dismissed.

units.source_text: 往年每逢此时，源氏家必然车马盈门，几无隙地。

en.t: In past years, whenever this time came, Genji's residence would be crowded with carriages and horses, leaving almost no space at the gate.

units.source_text: 桐壶院在位时自不必说，退位之后还是照旧不变。

en.t: That had naturally been true while Emperor Kiritsubo was on the throne, and even after his abdication nothing had changed.
This year, however, the front gate was deserted.

units.source_text: 带了铺盖前来值宿的人，一个也没有。

en.t: Not a single person came with bedding to spend the night on duty.

units.source_text: 只有几个老管家空闲无事地坐着。

en.t: Only a few old stewards sat there idly with nothing to do.

units.source_text: 源氏大将看到这光景，心念今后气数已尽，不胜凄凉之感。

en.t: Seeing this scene, General Genji thought that his fortunes from now on were exhausted, and he was overcome with desolation.
